failure: Fallback decoder starts but never finishes, with no error
detection: Status stuck on "Decoding with ffmpeg.wasm", no result and no error
mitigation: Fixed: worker emitted by the bundler, 16 kHz decode, watchdog on load and exec — a stuck run now fails with a message.
notes: Fixed 2026-11-01: worker resolved by the bundler; decode pinned to 16 kHz; watchdog bounds load and exec. Verified with AVI.

failure: The tab stops painting while a chunk is being transcribed
detection: UI unresponsive for ~5 s per 30 s chunk
blast_radius: Progress appears frozen though the run continues
mitigation: Yield a macrotask between chunks so each update paints; progress stays chunk-granular. A Web Worker for inference is the durable fix (ORT proxy worker failed to load its wasm from /ort/).
notes: Measured 2026-11-01: 3 chunks, ~5 s freeze each, updates at 33/67/100 %.
